paper.title: Fin-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Representation Learning for Financial Time Series

prerequisites.evidence: Public repository cloned read-only at the recorded commit. Upstream code was not executed.
README declares MIT; the tracked tree has no LICENSE file. Permission scope and dependency licenses need confirmation before reuse.
Reproducibility statement identifies the full feature dataset as private.
Unauthenticated GET https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/cedwyh/fin-jepa-data returned HTTP 401 at audit time; it does not establish whether authorized access is obtainable.
Full checkpoint/logs are in private cedricwyh/chan-jepa. No checkpoint was supplied for this audit.
6230 equities, 22 features, 30 context and 10 target steps; train 2010-2023, selection 2024, test 2025-2026.

Public dataset perctrix/Stock-China-daily API returned HTTP 200, private=false, gated=false, declared license apache-2.0, revision 1cdaed826ecb77f1ce0412cae16c049a46701750. Data bytes, provenance, redistribution rights and feature equivalence were not verified.
Preparation selects up to 800 sorted tickers, computes 11 features and 65-step windows, and normalizes combined data before any split. This differs from the paper baseline.
Full dataset's exchange timezone, as-of adjustments, delisting coverage, constituent selection and per-feature availability timestamps are unavailable.

Paper reports chronological years, but public train_jepa.py divides concatenated sequences by row position. Date membership, cross-boundary windows and train-only preprocessing cannot be established for private data.
Abstract describes four predictor layers; selected v4_deep_d64 results describe six. Resolve the exact checkpoint/config before asserting equivalence.

CLI defaults: latent64, encoder4, predictor6, SIGReg projections128/lambda0.1, batch512, AdamW lr0.001/weight_decay0.00001, cosine schedule, epochs200. These are executable defaults, not a verified reconstruction of the reported 50-epoch run.
No complete pinned environment and seed ledger tying the reported full-scale run to the public source was established.
Reported full training uses A10G and 50 epochs. Local device compatibility, memory, wall time and cost have not been measured.

If access cannot be obtained, register an independently named public-data protocol with explicit universe/features, timestamp rules, train-only transforms, chronological non-overlapping target boundaries and separate untouched evaluation. Never label Treasury YieldJEPA or this substitute an exact Fin-JEPA replication.

release_gates: Confirm code/data permission and record artifact revisions and hashes.
Resolve architecture, feature, universe, timestamp and split identities; list every substitution.
Freeze seeds, dependencies, selection metric and resource limits in a new protocol before execution.
Run a permissible bounded smoke with finite loss/gradients, dimensional checks and leakage assertions; retain environment, timing and memory evidence.
Only after smoke verification register a reduced study; reserve evaluation before selection and retain paired date/seed identities.
Paper-equivalent metrics require demonstrated equivalence, not merely similar model architecture.
